name: The Sultan and His Harem
source: The Sultan and His Harem is an adult strategy and relationship game where players step into the role of Suli, ruling the Ottoman Empire while building the most exquisite and diverse harem in history.
translation: 《苏丹与他的后宫》（The Sultan and His Harem）是一款成人策略恋爱养成游戏，玩家将扮演苏里统治奥斯曼帝国，同时打造出历史上最华美绝伦、千姿百态的后宫。
